questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Danny is the __better__ basketball player in the team.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "best".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is a use of** "the" **before the underlined **adjective**.
 
• The** superlative degree** of a verb should be used after the article **"the"**.
 
• When describing something that is at the upper or lower extent of quality, superlative adjectives are utilized (the tallest, the smallest, the fastest, the highest).
 
• The sentence structure will be **Noun (subject) + verb + the + superlative adjective + noun (object)**.

So the correct sentence will be **Danny is the best__**** basketball player in the team**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Good** is the **positive degree** but it does not use after **"the"**.
 
• **Most** is an **adverb** and also a superlative degree of** "more"** which is an adverb. This will not be making sense before basketball.
 
• **Gooder** is the **comparative degree **of the verb "good".

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

He does not trust anybody.

options.text: Anybody is not to be trusted by him.
Anybody is trusted not by him.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Nobody is trusted by him"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in a negative and **active voice.** and it needs to be changed to **passive voice**.
 
• The **passive voice** is used to express interest in the subject of an action rather than the subject or object that actually performs it.
 
• The** rule for structuring** the sentence of **passive voice** is :
 
 
• The object will be changed into the **subject**.
 
• "Does not" will be changed into **"is"**.
 
• And the main verb will be used in **past participle form**.
 
 
 
• Here the object is **"anybody"**.But as it is in **negative form**, we should use nobody as the **subject of passive voice** and the verb will be in **past participle form.**

So the answer will be **Nobody is trusted by him**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see another example of **passive voice**.
 
• You have an **active voice** when the actor (and the actor can be a person or an object) appears **before the action** in a sentence.
 
• The **passive voice** is used to express interest in the subject of **an action** rather than the **subject or object** that actually performs it.
 
• **Example: **I took the pen. **(Active voice)**
 
 
• The pen was taken by me. **(Passive voice)**
